sourceFile: 35. TIU C11-20  Report test Yoke difference color lever 3 from myunjin vendor 2026.05.06_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft is comparable but needs correction for the true yoke color level change and omitted drop-test evidence.
issues: Changed factor is too generic and should reflect yoke color Level 3 vs Normal.
Drop-test outcome rows are omitted despite being a major validation domain.
Measurement outcome from header row appears spurious and should not be final evidence.
Decision and attribution rows are not cited for final conclusions.
Myunjin/vendor context is not clearly separated from the tested condition.
correctionPlan: Rename changed factor to tested yoke color Level 3 versus Normal, with Myunjin as context unless baseline supplier differs.
Add drop-test outcome using rows 56-62, noting final auto NG was attributed to other causes.
Remove the header-only measurement outcome unless real measurement rows support it.
Add conclusion and attribution citations from rows 70 and 72-75.
Keep array, visual, decap, function outcomes under the same changed-factor validation report.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are incomplete; add drop-test, attribution, and decision rows before approval.
